sloka: कैलासमग्र्यं हिमवच्छिलां च तथर्षभं काञ्चनशैलमग्र्यम्।सन्दीप्तसर्वौषधिसम्प्रदीप्तं ददर्श सर्वौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रम् ।। ६.७४.६१ ।।
transliteration: kailāsamagryaṁ himavacchilāṁ ca tatharṣabhaṁ kāñcanaśailamagryam।sandīptasarvauṣadhisampradīptaṁ dadarśa sarvauṣadhiparvatendram ।। 6.74.61 ।।

translations.english: Observing the herbs blazing like fire, he was astonished at the herbs on the mountain and went round thinking of the names of herbs (asked by Jambavan).
